meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 执行计划时，Claude会变成调度员，自己只协调和验收；每个阶段派实施子代理照文档干活，不凭空猜接口；阶段结束派验证、反模式、代码质量子代理检查，通过才提交；阶段间同步分支并交接。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实某个计划时触发，尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 请执行这个按阶段划分的实施计划。
say.note: Claude会分派子代理逐阶段实现并验证。

say.text: 运行 make-plan 生成的那份计划。
say.note: 只有每阶段验证通过后，才会提交代码。

say.text: 把方案完整跑完，并做好检查。
say.note: 阶段收尾会自动派验证、反模式、代码质量子代理。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates: an implementation subagent edits code per docs for each phase; verification, anti-pattern, and code-quality checks gate commits; branch sync/handoff happens between phases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.note: Claude deploys subagents and verifies each phase.

say_en.text: Run the plan that make-plan generated.
Carry out the whole plan and run checks.
say_en.note: Runs verification, anti-pattern, and code-quality checks.
